hero.title: One link. Every playlist.
hero.description: Synqit lets you build collaborative event playlists and share personal playlists across streaming platforms — all through a single magic link.

offer.eventDescription: Create a playlist, generate a magic link, and let guests add tracks directly from their phone — no app download, no account required.
offer.syncDescription: Pick a playlist from your library and share it. Anyone with a Synqit account can subscribe and always get the latest tracks — even if they're on a different streaming service.
offer.syncStep3: Subscribers sign in & stay in sync

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.nativeBody: All changes sync automatically. Moderate tracks, reorder, or close an event directly in Spotify or Apple Music — Synqit keeps everything in step.
features.magicLinkBody: Guests land on a clean, mobile-first page. They search your catalog, pick a track, and it appears in your playlist in seconds — zero friction.
features.crossPlatformBody: Works with Spotify and Apple Music. Host on one, guests join from the other. Tracks route seamlessly to your provider.
features.moderationBody: You decide what stays. Review every suggestion, remove tracks, and close the event when you're done — all without leaving the app.

why.title: Less friction. More music.
why.reason1Body: For event playlists, guests contribute in seconds via the magic link — no Synqit account, no app install.
why.reason2Body: Spotify and Apple Music supported. Share with anyone, regardless of their service.
why.reason3Body: Your playlist lives in your streaming app. Synqit syncs changes automatically.
why.reason4Body: Approve, remove, and close at any time. Your event, your rules.

finalCta.title: Launch your first collaborative playlist today.
finalCta.eventCtaBody: Let guests add tracks via magic link — no signup required.
finalCta.syncCtaBody: Share your playlist across platforms. Subscribers need a free Synqit account to follow.
